message.content: The largest planet that has been observed so far is the exoplanet **HD 100546 b**. It orbits the young star HD 100546 and has a radius of roughly **2.5 times that of Jupiter** (about 2.5 R_J). Its mass is estimated to be around 20 Jupiter masses, making it one of the most massive planets (or possibly a brown dwarf) detected to date.
